title: Holding Several Mold Remediation Jobs
content:
A customer may hold any number of Mold Remediation jobs at once, one for each growth location at each property. Each job has its own tier, protocol, agreement, clearance and invoice.

**Terms as they apply to the customer**

1. There is no maximum number of Mold Remediation jobs per customer.
2. One job covers one growth location at one property. Growth in a second location, or at a second property, is a separate job.
3. Tier, protocol, agreement, clearance and invoice belong to the individual job. Signing the agreement on one job does not sign another, and one job's clearance or invoice is not another job's.

| Hypothetical holding | Jobs |
|---|---|
| One property, growth in the basement and in the attic | Two jobs, one per growth location |
| Two rental properties, each with growth in a living area | Two jobs, one per property |
| One property, growth in the HVAC system only | One job |
